scripts.dev: sh -c 'npm run dev:server & npm run dev:client && wait'
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace client && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.test: npm run test:client && npm run test:server
scripts.test:e2e:client: start-server-and-test "npm run dev:client" http://localhost:4174 "npm run test:e2e --workspace client"
scripts.test:e2e: start-server-and-test "npm run serve:server" http://127.0.0.1:8787/api/health "npm run test:e2e:client"
scripts.verify: npm run check:lockfiles && npm run test:client && npm run build:client && npm run test:server && npm run build:server
